description: Split your daily calories into protein, carb and fat targets in grams, calories and percentages for your goal.

faqs.a: Protein is set from your body weight (2.2 g/kg when cutting, 2.0 g/kg otherwise), fat gets 25% of calories, and the remaining calories go to carbs.
Higher protein while cutting helps preserve muscle in a calorie deficit. When maintaining or bulking, 2.0 g/kg is a widely used guideline.
faqs.q: Why is protein higher when cutting?

faqs.a: It is a common starting split for general fitness goals. Athletes, medical conditions or strict diets (e.g. keto) need a customized plan from a professional.
faqs.q: Is this the right split for everyone?

howto: Enter your body weight in kg.
Choose your goal: cut, maintain or bulk.
Read your protein, fat and carb targets in grams, kcal and %.
title: Macro Split Calculator
